fieldValues.title: A website's pages and menu are written in code, not where its words are
fieldValues.statement: I need to change what the site says and how it is navigated from the editor where I write it. Today some muDemocracy pages and the whole menu are hand-written in Astro files, the nav sections are listed in three places, and the link between a block type and the component that draws it is a string match in code, so a new page, a menu entry or a dropdown needs a developer and a deploy.
source_ref: muDemocracy.org commit 5fcde90 (adding one nav item touched five files)
